note: Small roadside camping spot on the south side of Old Highway 60 just west of Dudley: a short gravel pull-in loop with a mown grass clearing and a picnic area beside it, backed by bottomland woods. It is one spot beside the road rather than a campground, with no other facilities, and spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites' - one mapped Primitive Camping symbol and GIS point on a grass clearing beside the small pull-in lot and picnic area on Old Hwy 60; free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Not waterfront kept. Pin fine. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION (lot rule - stays): the area page lists 'Camping: Individual Campsites'; the 1/12/2023 map draws a Primitive Camping symbol beside the Picnic Area and Parking Lot symbols on Old Hwy 60, and GIS layer 27 has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point (OBJECTID 543) there. The brochure says 'Primitive camping is permitted only in designated areas on the area map'. So MDC designates a camping point; it is more than the lot, but only just: on imagery the pull-in is a ~15 x 25 m gravel loop straight off the paved road with a ~30 x 35 m mown clearing west of it, where the camping point sits (19 m from the lot centre). A 23-ft rig fits the loop or the clearing edge; no ford, 4WD note or posted limit. It is ~25 m from Old Hwy 60 and ~250 m north of a railroad.
PIN: stored 36.79049,-90.10744 = GIS camping point 543 on the open clearing beside the lot - fine.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): no water at the spot (a farm pond lies across the highway on private land).
PHONE: (573) 290-5730 on the area page matches. (The brochure's contact block gives Otter Slough CA, (573) 624-5821.)
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored; the brochure gives no camping season.
